notes.title: The Carrier and Crows Polish Update and Demo 2.0
notes.content:
Hey all,

After some time away from this project, I decided to revisit and clean up some of the games shortcomings.

Here are the changes I've made:

New features:
-Added an interactive map that can be accessed with the M key.
-Added a white embers effect and windchime sound when close to any interactable objects
-Added outlines for the choppable chunks in the Giant Tree Trunk.
-Added death screen with situational advise depending on death type
-Cleaned up the audio ducking for all death transitions, menu transitions, and loading screens
-Cleaned up the audio cue distances from some placeable items

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed awkward camera movement during some of the cutscenes and events.
-Fixed Rifles not deactivating sometimes on death during Crow Bear sequence.
-Fixed some out of place foliage
-Fixed interaction distance being too long

Balance Changes:
-Increased The day length in the day night cycle substantially.
-Added more ways to reset the time of day in some biomes.
-reduced the number of chops to break a giant tree chunk from 3 to 2


Demo 2.0
-The demo has been updated to include all post launch changes
(this includes a difficulty setting, a new and improved opening tutorial, an in game objectives help menu, and many more accessibility and stability changes) 
(Please see the list of small patches on the news page of the community hub for more details)
-Both swamp biome objective sets and part of the cave sequence are now playable in the demo
(Meet the swamp biomes menacing under-lord, and creator of the rock formations in the area)

That's all for now, but on a side note, I'd like to say that, though I still have a ways to go, my next game is shaping up to be something quite different, and I'm looking forward to sharing more soon.

Best regards, IceBathGames.

notes.title: Patch 1.07 is now live.
notes.content:
Fixed gathered items that drop 0 quantity adding a blank item to the inventory.
Fixed closing the inventory while dragging an item causing mismatched inventory.

notes.title: Patch1.06 is now live.
notes.content:
This Patch Includes:

-Added visuals to the opening tutorial and trimmed down some of the text.
-Added an item info popup window when hovering an item in the inventory.
-Increased the duration of day cycles, night cycles are still the same duration.
-Added options in the graphics menus for vsync and max FPS.
-Fixed screen resolution settings on first launch for computers running at a scaled desktop size.

notes.title: Patch 1.05 is now live
notes.content:
This patch Includes:

-Fixed some key inventories not loading properly under certain circumstances.
-Fixed screen resolution and screen mode not being applied properly on first launch.

notes.title: Patch 1.04 is now live.
notes.content:
This patch includes:

-Added buttons to close all menus, the esc key works to close all menus across the board, as well as the inventory key to close the main inventory and the interact key to close all secondary inventories for placeables, key inventories and tool box inventories.

-Added Difficulty slider to the start of the game. This affects the amount of resources required for both learning and learned recipes. It can be set from 0.5x to 1.5x. If you have and existing save the amount of resources required for all recipes will not have changed. If you would like to play with modified resource requirements, please start a new game from the main menu.

-Added confirmation menus when closing the beginning tutorial and when selecting your difficulty at the start of the game.

-Fixed arrows getting stuck mid air when shooting a moving target that doesn't receive damage.

notes.title: The Carrier and Crows 1.03 is now live
notes.content:
-Added a pop up notice that triggers when trying to gather or swim with no health.
-Added a Modifier Key that can be used in combination with left click to add resources to crafting lists faster.
-Added a new key bind entry in the controls menu to customize the crafting Modifier Key.
-Updated the opening tutorial to include info on the Modifier Key.
-Increased the drop rate of meat and rawhide from rabbits.
-Fixed the first hit on tree clusters not producing any drops.
-Added points of interest to the map found at the start of the game.
-Added Documents submenu to the pause menu that saves all found documents for viewing anytime in game.

Notes:
-If you have an existing save you may need to reapply the modifier key bind from the controls menu.
-If you have an existing save the documents you have already found wont be available in the documents menu. The map will always be available no matter your game state though.

notes.title: Update adding an opening tutorial and objectives help menu is now live.
notes.content:
Hey all,

For those having trouble finding their way in the Carrier and Crows, I've added some more easily accessible info on the games various mechanics.

Now when you start a new game you will have the option to read a brief tutorial about the basics such as the workings of the crafting window, interacting with landmarks and so on.

There is also now an objectives tab in the pause menu, where you will find drop down lists for the biomes you have visited. For each objective is a dropdown that explains the mechanics for that objective. so If your stuck on an objective you can visit the objectives menu and find the objective your having trouble with.

I am also keeping busy working on my next game and look forward to sharing more on that soon, but will continue to support the Carrier and Crows as long as it has an audience.

Good luck and I hope you enjoy my game!

notes.title: Added some fixes and functionality changes to the controls and graphics menus
notes.content:
Graphics menu:

-The list of selectable resolutions is now dependent on the users desktop aspect ratio, so if the desktop aspect ratio is 16:9, only resolutions with that aspect ratio will be displayed.
This is to prevent non uniform scaling of the UI and mouse cursor location disparity.

-Windowed Fullscreen has been disabled.
This is to avoid mismatching resolutions in the menu, as Unreal Engine locks the resolution in this mode.
The same results can be obtained by setting the window mode to windowed and the resolution to your monitors native resolution.

Controls menu:

-Added options to bind the left and right attack buttons.

General Notes:
**If you have an exiting save, you may need to reapply your settings.
